newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks under presure from techs at midday.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks under presure from techs at midday.

text.p: Weakness in the high technology sector kept most Wall Street stocks trading lower at midday Monday despite a firm bond market.
Analysts said that a correction in the sector has extended to such superstars as Microsoft Corp and Intel Corp, which means that it may be drawing to an end.

The Dow industrials, trading in a narrow range around Friday's close, were up one at 6806, while declines led advancing issues by 14 to nine on volume of 214 million shares. The Nasdaq Composite fell 15 to 1239.
U.S. Treasuries were mostly higher, with the long bond up 9/32 to yield 6.94 percent.
"The techs were overowned and overbought and headed for a shakeout," said Larry Wachtel analyst at Prudential Securities.

Microsoft, the most actively traded Nasdaq issue was down 4-1/2 at 89-1/2, Intel was down 2-1/4 at 128-1/4, Hewlett-Packard Co fell 1-1/2 to 55-1/8 while International Business Machines Corp was up 7/8 at 133-1/4.
"The correction in techs is following a natural course," said Tony O'Bryan, technical analyst at A.G. Edwards & Sons.
